summary: Collections for any game: an album of card sets with set rewards and a grand prize, packs and chests, trading spare cards with friends.
description: A ready collections screen (engine Collection) for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.collection. Album: the player's collection with every set in order — the cards held (with how many) and the gaps, a reward to claim per completed set and a grand prize for the whole album. Packs: every pack type with every way to pay, opened once or ten at a time (the server rolls them — new cards and duplicates are shown), and collection chests bought with the points duplicates turn into. Trades: offers from other players (accept / decline), your own offers (cancel), and giving a spare card to a friend. Registers the 'collections' feature; its badge counts set rewards and the grand prize waiting. Ships title-seed.json: a small album with sets, a pack and a chest.
provides: card packs, once or ten at a time
